name: BHUPENDRA KUMAR
summary: Highly motivated and experienced Backend Developer with a strong passion for building scalable, distributed systems and cloud-native applications. Proficient in Python, FastAPI, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, with a proven track record of delivering high-performance REST APIs, real-time data processing pipelines, and fault-tolerant microservices.

experience.title: Backend Software Engineer
responsibilities: Designed and maintained highly scalable, production-grade backend systems using Python and FastAPI, serving over 50,000 daily active requests.
Architected a distributed, event-driven microservices ecosystem utilizing Kafka and Rabbit MQ, ensuring fault tolerance and high-throughput real-time data processing.
Optimized application performance and complex SQL operations; implemented Redis caching layers that reduced average database query load times by 45%.
Integrated backend services with AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS) and managed containerized application deployments using Docker and Kubernetes orchestration.
Spearheaded the implementation of automated CI/CD deployment workflows using Git Hub Actions and Jenkins, cutting deployment friction and improving system reliability.

experience.title: Google Developer Group Lead
responsibilities: Collaborate directly with cross-functional teams (frontend, Dev Ops) to lead 15 developers in building a highly scalable, full-stack event management platform.
Built secure REST APIs using Django and Flask, enforcing strict authentication, authorization, and backend security best practices (OWASP standards).
Organized and led large-scale technical events, including the ”Prompt Craft” and ”Reimagination Hackathon”, mentoring students in system design and backend architecture.
